experience.label: 04 - EXPERIENCE
experience.title: Experience built around delivery
experience.subtitle: I have worked across product, platform, and internal systems with consistent ownership in production environments.

devtest.description: Team Lead of the development and testing department, a team of under 8 engineers, also acting as Senior Software Engineer and owning the cycle from requirements to production release.

highlights.1: Lead the development and testing department, a team of under 8 engineers covering frontend, backend and QA, while also acting as Senior Software Engineer on the codebase.
highlights.2: Shipped an agribusiness ERP for coffee production, live on 5 farms and expanding, by mapping harvest, stock and traceability workflows into a Next.js and Hasura Cloud platform.
highlights.3: Delivered Kibera, a business management and invoicing suite for the Angolan market, by architecting it in Next.js and PayloadCMS with compliant fiscal document generation.
highlights.4: Delivered 10+ enterprise web, desktop and mobile platforms by creating a shared TypeScript component library reused across Tauri, Electron and React Native.
highlights.5: Integrated AI features into client and in-house products by combining Hugging Face LLM inference, embedding based matching and AI assisted decision rules over PostgreSQL.
highlights.6: Own deployment and hosting for the delivered frontend projects, including FEMB, by managing releases on Netlify and Vercel and configuring domains and subdomains end to end.
highlights.7: Standardised engineering practice across the team by enforcing code review on every pull request, GitFlow branching and Docker based environments.

tailordeal.description: Tech Lead of DealBusinessHub, a European marketplace for real estate and business transactions, on Blazor and .NET 8.

highlights.1: Led the technical direction of DealBusinessHub, a European marketplace connecting brokers, investors and business owners, by architecting a modular Blazor and .NET 8 platform on PostgreSQL.
highlights.2: Reduced page load time across the listings area by optimising Entity Framework queries, adding server-side caching and lazy loading heavy Blazorise components.
highlights.3: Kept the platform available across both cloud and legacy targets by deploying and maintaining infrastructure on AWS and Azure alongside the SmartASP IIS hosting environment.
highlights.4: Kept the codebase consistent as the platform grew by enforcing static code analysis and peer reviewed pull requests on every change.
highlights.5: Kept a predictable release cadence on a distributed team by running Jira sprint planning and enforcing GitFlow branching.

eco.description: Senior developer and tech lead on an education product, helping shape delivery and interface quality for a platform serving real students and operators.

highlights.1: Owned frontend delivery quality for a live education product.
highlights.2: Worked across dashboards, learning flows, and operational interfaces.
highlights.3: Contributed as a senior individual contributor with leadership responsibility.

gclucan.description: Senior Software Engineer and Technical Lead for the KITANDASOFT suite and SIKOLASOFT, software used daily by 300+ active businesses across Angola.

highlights.1: Led engineering for the KITANDASOFT suite (ERP, POS, restaurant, invoicing, CRM) and SIKOLASOFT, reaching 300+ active business customers across Angola.
highlights.2: Delivered SIKOLASOFT, a complete school management platform, by building its administrative, pedagogical, academic and financial modules in C# and ASP.NET on MariaDB.
highlights.3: Built the shared reporting and invoicing engine used by all five products in the suite by designing a reusable class library with DevExpress and XtraReports.
highlights.4: Modernised the CRM module by migrating it from ASP.NET WebForms to Blazor and .NET 8, reducing page response time.
highlights.5: Kept all five products available to customers by administering the on-premises IIS hosting environment and piloting a migration path to Azure.
highlights.6: Grew the team as Team Lead and head of the development area by mentoring 3+ interns to full autonomy through pairing and code review.
highlights.7: Shipped the frontend of a hotel management system by pairing React and TailwindCSS with a Node.js API.

snir.description: Software developer focused on backend services, reporting and database administration for insurance and banking systems.

highlights.1: Built and maintained International Insurance, a full insurance management system, acting on backend services, database administration and DevOps in C# and ASP.NET on Microsoft SQL Server.
highlights.2: Delivered NZIMBUPAY, a banking application, by owning senior report development and backend features in C#, ASP.NET and DevExpress.
highlights.3: Kept both systems reliable in production across three years by administering the SQL Server databases and resolving reporting incidents as the dedicated DBA.

teclat.description: Frontend engineer focused on transactional product flows for a remittance and exchange platform.

highlights.1: Built validation-heavy transactional flows with strong UX requirements.
highlights.2: Worked on authentication, exchange calculation, and responsive forms.
highlights.3: Contributed to a product where user trust depended on interface clarity and correctness.

xgrow.description: Frontend engineer on an education platform, contributing to core product features in a remote team context.

highlights.1: Delivered product features used in a live learning environment.
highlights.2: Worked inside a structured delivery process with GitFlow, Jira, and collaborative engineering routines.
highlights.3: Built maintainable UI logic for a real product, not one-off pages.

kiari.description: Frontend developer at an Angolan software company, owning the company website end to end and building the Kiari Events application for organisers and customers.

highlights.1: Built the complete company website, owning the application from scratch.
highlights.2: Kiari Events: event application covering both the organiser side and the customer side, with React, Redux and GraphQL.
highlights.3: Built with React, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, GraphQL and Chakra UI, with geolocation features.
highlights.4: Modern React ecosystem: Vite, Redux Toolkit, Context API and GraphQL integration.

zenitech.description: Fullstack developer at a Brazilian software company, building websites, systems and landing pages for ed-tech clients.

highlights.1: Aligner-Flix: production landing page for a Brazilian ed-tech client.
highlights.2: Delivered fullstack work from frontend to backend, including website creation and bug fixes.
highlights.3: Stack: React, Angular, PHP, Node.js and WordPress.
